import html # Example invitation format template INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def prepare_event_details( headline: str, summary: str, scheduled_date: str, additional_info: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation string. Parameters ---------- headline : str Title or name of the event. summary : str Comprehensive description (may contain multiple paragraphs). scheduled_date : str Scheduled date of the event. additional_info : str Supplementary information or instructions. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape all user-provided content to neutralize special characters escaped_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) escaped_summary = html.escape(summary, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") escaped_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) escaped_info = html.escape(additional_info, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Build the final HTML using a safe template invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=escaped_headline, event_description=escaped_summary, event_date=escaped_date, additional_notes=escaped_info ) return invitation_html
